fixture.database: file-backed WAL/FULL, complete product migrations, renderer gateway adapter over Node SQLite
fixture.trace: one prior committed turn and one two-iteration mixed turn: consolidated thinking, text, streamed tool arguments, one success and one failure, usage and terminal
fixture.composition: real journal consumer, persistence adapter, repositories and strict recovery; synchronous state/activity ports; no model, tool execution, React or native process

limitations: SIGKILL terminates an owned Node process. It does not simulate OS crash, disk failure or power loss.
This covers real SQLite and consumer/recovery composition, not the full Zustand store, transport relay, React display, native Rust gateway or device input.
Recovery here is read-only. Resuming interrupted tools, write receipts, permissions, user controls, checkpoint compaction and large-history latency remain separate acceptance.
